  -- Sets in Racers theme or sub-themes, released in 2012

    i.set_num,
    i.id as inventory_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) as rn
  FROM inventories i

-- Recursive explosion of contents
recursive_contents AS (
  -- Base: start with sets in Racers 2012, their inventory parts
  SELECT 
    rs.set_num as root_set,
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    ip.quantity as qty,
    1 as level
  FROM racers_sets rs
  JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = rs.set_num AND ci.rn = 1
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    ip.color_id,
